681136946f.q: Why are major banks like JPMorgan blocking AI agents like Instinct and Muse from accessing customer accounts?

7f0b361701.q: What was the Bank of America anti-money laundering fine and what compliance lessons does it teach about AI automation?
7f0b361701.a: Bank of America was fined for over a billion dollars for anti-money laundering deficiencies. The key lesson is that using automation is not enough; regulators require independent validation of the automation, proper weighting of controls, human-in-the-loop review, and alignment with current regulatory guidance. Banks must ensure they have the right controls, humans, and guardrails in place.

e7ce982083.q: How does Bretton AI customize agents for different banks given varying compliance requirements?
e7ce982083.a: Bretton AI onboards agents the same way banks onboard human AML staff: by providing context about what the bank does, what products it offers, what customer types it serves, what normal transaction patterns look like, what historically suspicious patterns triggered SARs, and operational guidelines. Agents then learn from feedback during live investigations, improving their understanding of what constitutes suspicious activity for that specific institution.
